history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-21: zoo owner, "do all of those" (the ideas offered). Pilots and small runs, all classes; the Rangers are set aside.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build at 200,000 turns was read (borg-zoo#548). Pilot (RULES 16) at
200,000 turns, because at 100,000 turns ctl has no deaths to improve on. Six arms, 18 starts each (108 games), all
classes. Evidence: of 73 deaths in the evening's 3,384 games, Fang and Grip 13 (nine are one Mage at CL8), wild cat 5,
soldier 3.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's list lines applied (the cell's user copy of scary_monsters.txt); ctl
plays as main 2801ba18's shipped settings; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts
classified.
Report per arm and per class: deaths and causes (Fang, Grip, soldier, acolyte named), CL at death, final and maximum
level, deepest level; paired rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), identical plays; for each arm the
starts where the changed monster was met (scare or attack notes), so an arm that never meets it is "not tested".
Descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main 2801ba18 at 200,000 turns, do a higher scary level for Fang and Grip, the dogs as kill-on-sight, and a higher scary level for soldiers and acolytes save the deaths they cause, without new ones?
